t: NixOS Upgrade Strategy and Command Overview
s: This article explores the benefits of NixOS and its deterministic package management, highlighting the `nixos-rebuild switch --upgrade` command as a core habit for users, analogous to `apt upgrade` but with a more involved build process and robust rollback capabilities.
sub: The `nixos-rebuild switch --upgrade` command and its implications
Configuration as Code (IaC) and hardware configuration
Nix flakes for modularity and portability
